records.title: NEW SKILL DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME.
details: c: MSDE in collaboration with the Women Entrepreneurship Platform of NITI Aayog, has launched the Swavalambini- a women Entrepreneurship Program om 07.02.2025 in the North Eastern States of Assam. Meghalaya and Mizoram and on 01.03.2025 in Uttar Pradesh and Telangana. MSDE will implement the program through its autonomous institutes namely, NIESBUD and IIE.
